_provenance.what: L3 HAND-OFF — published spells whose expectation cannot be stated without STATE, recorded rather than forced (#930 fence 1).
_provenance.rule: A row lands here if and only if l2_reference.expectation_of() derives no stateless effect family for it. The L2 suite asserts this set is EXACT in both directions: a row the oracle can express must never be parked here (coverage laundering), and a row it cannot express must never be silently dropped.
_provenance.adjudicator: L3 twin parity — the same command stream through @aresrpg/sim and through Move on localnet, per beat.
